overall_reason: An Ant Design app built on Ant's token set (784 --ant-* references, radii 6 and 8px all on tokens), but the Pro layout chrome renders Ant v4's primary #1890ff and 0.85 text while the table and cards render v5's #1677ff and 0.88, so the primary role exists twice.

score.reason: T-SCALE-FIT and T-TOKEN-TIERS pass; T-DRIFT-PAIRS and T-FRAMEWORK-FIT fail on two primaries and two text alphas from two framework versions (TOK-010, TOK-011).

findings.where: side menu, tabs and table links, 1440 (tiles/1440-00.png)
findings.evidence: Two primaries render: the selected side-menu item text, the tab ink bar and one fill use #1890ff (Ant v4's primary), while the table links use #1677ff (v5's --ant-color-primary) (values.1440.colour_text and colour_fill examples). Text alpha also comes in pairs: #000000 at 0.85 in the list items beside 0.88 in headings and body.
findings.before: #1890ff and #1677ff for the primary role; 0.85 and 0.88 for primary text
findings.after: Every primary reads --ant-color-primary and every primary text --ant-color-text, so the Pro layout and the content share one theme
findings.why: Users see two blues for 'selected' and 'link' on one screen, and a theme change will move only one of them.
findings.root: Pro layout styles from an older Ant version

findings.evidence: Arbitrary classes retype Ant tokens as literals: .bg-[#1677ff] and .dark:bg-[#141414] (declarations.arbitrary_value_selectors), and 94 colour, 122 spacing and 48 font-size literals equal a declared token's value.
findings.after: Utilities reference the Ant tokens (bg-[var(--ant-color-primary)] or a theme mapping)
findings.why: Retyped primaries are exactly the values that drifted between versions.

findings.evidence: Surfaces pair #ffffff with #fafafa (table head) and #f5f5f5 (segmented control) (values.1440.colour_fill near_duplicates).
findings.after: The Ant container and fill tokens only
findings.why: Near-white fills a hair apart add values without adding contrast.

strengths: Radii are four values, all on Ant tokens (6px on 45 elements, 8px on 22, 4px and full).
Spacing sits on a 4px scale (share 0.909) with 94% on token values.
Durations are 100, 200 and 300ms, 99% on Ant's motion tokens.
not_investigated: inline style attributes: the DOM records computed styles only
token source files behind the shipped CSS (Sass, JSON tokens, Figma variables): only the shipped CSS was read
states the capture did not open (hover, focus, open menus): their values are not in the table
T-THEME-PARITY: a dark utility exists (dark:bg-[#141414]) but no dark token set; the dark mode was not rendered
the chart colours inside the dashboard cards are left to lens-dataviz
T-SYSTEM-DRIFT: no Ant token file supplied; drift was judged against the tokens the page declares
